_doc: Canonical runtime config for Riot Commander ops stack. This is the single source of truth for the supervisor, file bridge, and self-monitor. config/runtime.json is a legacy install-time file and is not read by the ops stack.
_admin_bridge_note: Set true ONLY for manual development sessions. NEVER in production. Enables shell/start_process in DevRuntime and run_powershell in FileBridge.
_self_monitor_note: Primary self-monitor settings live in config/self_monitor_profile.json. Settings below are supervisor-level overrides.
_authority_note: Config hierarchy: ops/rc_config.json (ops stack) > config/self_monitor_profile.json (monitor) > config/coach_settings.json (AI coaching). config/runtime.json is install-only, ignored at runtime.
